malaria.title: Malaria Prevention and Symptoms
malaria.content: I am not a doctor. To prevent malaria: 1) Sleep under treated nets, 2) Remove stagnant water near your home, 3) Wear long sleeves when possible. If you develop fever, chills, or body aches, visit a health facility for testing. Early treatment saves lives.
malaria.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Ili kuzuia malaria: 1) Lala chini ya mtungi unaozuiliwa na dawa, 2) Ondoa maji yamiyomvu karibu na nyumba, 3) Vaa nguo za muda mrefu. Ikiwa una homa, baridi au maumivu ya mwili, nenda kituo cha afya kwa kupima. Kutibu mapema kunaokoa maisha.

maternal_health.title: Safe Pregnancy and Antenatal Care
maternal_health.content: I am not a doctor. For a healthy pregnancy: 1) Start antenatal care early, 2) Attend all clinic visits, 3) Take iron supplements, 4) Eat nutritious food, 5) Report danger signs (bleeding, severe headache, chest pain) to a health facility immediately.
maternal_health.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Kwa ujauzito salama: 1) Anza huduma za kabla ya kuzaa mapema, 2) Tembelea kliniki kwa kila miadi, 3) Chukua virutubishi vya chuma, 4) Kula chakula chenye virutubishi, 5) Ripoti dalili za hatari (kupiga damu, maumivu makali ya kichwa, maumivu ya kifua) mara moja kwa kituo cha afya.

hiv_aids.title: HIV Prevention and Testing
hiv_aids.content: I am not a doctor. For HIV prevention: 1) Test regularly at a clinic, 2) Use protection consistently, 3) Know your status, 4) If exposed, seek PEP treatment within 72 hours. If positive, ARV treatment keeps you healthy. Seek professional HIV care at a health facility.
hiv_aids.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Kwa kuzuia HIV: 1) Fanya mtihani mara kwa mara kwa kliniki, 2) Tumia kinga kwa uhakika, 3) Jua hali yako, 4) Ikiwa umeambukizwa, tafuta PEP ndani ya saa 72. Ikiwa umewekwa, tiba ya ARV inakuweka salama. Tafuta huduma za HIV kwenye kituo cha afya.

nutrition.title: Balanced Diet and Nutrition
nutrition.content: I am not a doctor. For good nutrition: 1) Eat vegetables and fruits daily, 2) Include proteins (beans, eggs, fish), 3) Eat whole grains (maize, rice), 4) Drink clean water, 5) Limit sugar and salt. A healthy diet strengthens your immune system. Consult a health worker for specific dietary needs.
nutrition.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Kwa lishe nzuri: 1) Kula mboga na matunda kila siku, 2) Jumuisha protini (maharagwe, mayai, samaki), 3) Kula nafaka kamili (mahindi, mchele), 4) Kunywa maji safi, 5) Punguza sukari na chumvi. Lishe nzuri inaimarisha mfumo wako wa kinga.

mental_health.title: Mental Health and Stress Management
mental_health.content: I am not a doctor. For mental wellness: 1) Talk to friends or family, 2) Get 7-8 hours sleep, 3) Exercise regularly, 4) Reduce stress through prayer/meditation, 5) Seek professional help if you feel hopeless. There is no shame in mental health care. Visit a health facility to speak with a counselor.
mental_health.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Kwa ustawi wa akili: 1) Zungumza na marafiki au familia, 2) Lala saa 7-8, 3) Fanya mazoezi mara kwa mara, 4) Punguza msongo kwa kutafakari/kuwa mtulivu, 5) Tafuta msaada wa kitaalam ikiwa unahisi kukata tamaa. Hakuna aibu kutafuta huduma za afya ya akili.

waterborne_diseases.title: Preventing Waterborne Diseases (Cholera, Typhoid, Diarrhea)
waterborne_diseases.content: I am not a doctor. To prevent waterborne diseases: 1) Boil drinking water or use clean water source, 2) Wash hands with soap before eating, 3) Use a toilet (not open defecation), 4) Keep food covered from flies, 5) If diarrhea persists, seek medical care. Proper sanitation saves lives.
waterborne_diseases.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Ili kuzuia magonjwa ya maji: 1) Chemsha maji au tumia chanzo safi, 2) Osha mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kula, 3) Tumia choo, 4) Funika chakula dhidi ya inzi, 5) Ikiwa kuhara kunaendelea, tafuta huduma ya afya. Usafi unaokoa maisha.

child_health.title: Child Health and Immunization
child_health.content: I am not a doctor. For child health: 1) Follow the immunization schedule at clinics, 2) Give children nutritious food, 3) Provide clean water, 4) Seek care for fever or persistent cough, 5) A child with high fever or difficulty breathing needs urgent care. Ask a health worker about your child's development.
child_health.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Kwa afya ya mtoto: 1) Fuata ratiba ya chanjo katika kliniki, 2) Mpe mtoto chakula chenye lishe, 3) Toa maji safi, 4) Tafuta huduma kwa homa au kikohozi kinachoendelea, 5) Mtoto mwenye homa kubwa au shida ya kupumua anahitaji msaada wa haraka.

respiratory_health.title: Respiratory Infections and Cough Management
respiratory_health.content: I am not a doctor. For respiratory health: 1) Cover cough/sneeze with tissue, 2) Wash hands regularly, 3) Stay home if sick, 4) Drink warm liquids, 5) If cough persists more than 2 weeks or with blood, seek medical care. Always visit a clinic for difficulty breathing.
respiratory_health.contentSwahili: Mimi si daktari. Kwa afya ya mfumo wa kupumua: 1) Funika kukohoa/kutapika kwa tishu, 2) Osha mikono mara kwa mara, 3) Kaa nyumbani ikiwa mgonjwa, 4) Kunywa vinywaji vya moto, 5) Ikiwa kukohoa kunaendelea zaidi ya wiki 2 au kuna damu, tafuta msaada wa kiafya. Nenda kliniki kwa shida za kupumua.
